text:
helen: quick heads-up — we need consistent request-id + sampling propagation so console can show route-level latency/failed-token breakdowns by request flow. thinking this impacts routing policies + dashboards.
omar: agree. runtime can emit `X-Request-ID` and `X-Trace-Sampled`. do we want sampled=1/0 header or more detailed sampler-state? short is better.
raj: ingress/ingest team: heads up about cardinality — raw request_id as a metric label will explode. we should only use it for linking logs/traces, not as a time-series tag.
sophie: for dashboard UX we want to allow: "group by route, then drill into example traces by request id". so need stable header we can plumb through logs -> traces -> console. :+1:
omar: runtime plan: attach `X-Request-ID` to all internal RPCs and include `trace_context` in logs. sampling decision is made at edge (api-gateway) and forwarded via `X-Trace-Sampled: 1|0`.
helen: that works. console will add a drilldown widget that queries traces by `request_id` when a route/latency anomaly is selected.
tia: rollout ops: propose feature-flagged rollout for 2 weeks: start with internal traffic only, then customers opt-in. also toggle to disable header for privacy-sensitive customers.
alex: quota/cost note: sampling rate change affects APM ingest and trace storage. need to coordinate quota bump requests before increasing sample rate on prod.
raj: ingest mapping suggestion: store `request_hash` (low-cardinality) as metric and keep full `request_id` only in logs/traces. example: `request_hash = sha256(request_id)[:8]`.
sophie: perfect — dashboard can show `request_hash` rollups and then fetch full trace by `request_id` when drilling.
omar: sample policy draft (will put in repo):
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.01
  route_overrides:
    /v1/chat: 0.2
    /v1/generate: 0.05
headers:
  trace_id: X-Request-ID
  sampled: X-Trace-Sampled
```
helen: small example for SDKs and curl for onboarding docs:
`curl -H "X-Request-ID: $(uuidgen)" -H "X-Trace-Sampled: 1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat`
omar: runtime will also emit a `trace.span_id` and `trace.parent_id` in logs for easy linking.
raj: ingest team needs schema change ticket for logs -> traces linking and `request_hash` field. I'll open it.
tia: rollout checklist items: 1) docs + SDK note, 2) feature flag, 3) quota check, 4) dashboard widgets staged in staging, 5) customer opt-in flow.
helen: assigning tasks: @raj open schema ticket, @omar add headers + sampling config PR, @sophie prototype dashboard widget, @tia own rollout checklist.
alex: add a cost estimate doc please — I'll review before any sample rate increases.
mike: can we sync tomorrow 11am PT? 30m to align infra/runtime/console. I'll send invite. :calendar:
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for runtime sampling header rollout at 2024-07-22T02:00Z.
helen: thanks all — main goal: trace correlation for dashboards without exploding metrics cardinality. will follow up after the sync with AIs/actions. :rocket:
